purpose: Preserve the evidence and implementation before subsequent federation optimizations; support a research-paper experiment lineage.
anchor_rule: First full 113-query version-2 pass in the DuckDB/Accio measurement sequence; selected by chronology, not fastest observed total. Compare Datalevin over all 113 original answers.

studies.note: Historical format-1 evidence; Drill comparison includes 20 documented dialect reruns. Preserve the original failures and all paired controls.
Format-2 full passes and six-query alias reruns remain separate. Accio uses the documented stock-DuckDB compatibility bridge. Dingo was not run.

limitations: One timed observation per query and mode, zero explicit warmups; exploratory coverage evidence rather than statistical or causal evidence.
Original dataset archive checksums unavailable; retained source catalog counts are estimates.
Versions, settings, plans, raw answers, failures, actual/submitted SQL and native controls are retained in each study.
Working trees were dirty. Measured-resource snapshots identify the original implementation; additional source trees are snapshots at freeze time, not proof every byte was measured.
No source database files, Maven caches, engine distributions, private credentials, or build outputs are included.
Historical optimization measurements are retained as context; they do not substitute for isolated ablations.
Do not combine studies with different correct-query subsets or phases into an unqualified full-suite speedup.
